fields.name: title
fields.description: The descriptive name of the board.

fields.name: description
fields.description: A textual explanation or summary of the board.

fields.name: stage
fields.description: The current status or lifecycle phase of the board.

fields.name: position
fields.description: The sequential order of this item within a collection.

events.name: OPEN_CARD
events.description: Indicates a card within the board has been selected.

events.name: CLOSE_CARD
events.description: Signals a card is being dismissed or closed.

events.name: ADD_CARD
events.description: Signals a new card is being added to the board.

events.name: SAVE_CARD
events.description: Signals that a card's data has been successfully saved.

events.name: MOVE_CARD
events.description: Signals a card has been repositioned within a column.

events.name: REORDER_CARD
events.description: Signals a change in the order of cards within a column.

events.name: DELETE_CARD
events.description: Signals removal of a card from the board.

events.name: EDIT_CARD
events.description: Signals a request to edit the currently open card. The board renders no edit form itself — consumers override cardActionsContent with an Edit button and wire this emit to their edit modal/form trait.

events.name: BoardItemsLoaded
events.description: Signals that board items have been successfully loaded.

events.name: BoardItemsLoadFailed
events.description: Indicates a failure to load board items.

events.name: BoardItemsSaved
events.description: Signals that board items have been successfully saved.

events.name: BoardItemDeleted
events.description: Signals a board item has been deleted; carries the deleted row's id, not the row.

events.name: BoardItemsSaveFailed
events.description: Indicates a failure to save board items.

events.name: REORDER_POSITION
events.description: Indicates a change in the order of items within a column.

events.name: REFETCH_QUERY
events.description: Triggers a board refresh based on the current search query.

events.name: REFETCH_FILTER
events.description: Triggers a board refresh based on current filter criteria.

events.name: REFETCH_PAGE
events.description: Triggers a board refresh for a given page. std-board itself renders no pagination control; this exists so a composed std-pagination can drive one.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Add button placement
overridableConfigKeys.description: Where the add-item button sits: 'floating' (default) pins a floating action button to the screen corner; 'inline' renders an ordinary Add button above the columns, for a board embedded in a card or panel.; none hides the add button (a read-only board)
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: add button position, floating add, inline add, add item button placement. user phrases: 'put the add button inside the board' / 'no floating button' -> inline

overridableConfigKeys.label: Board look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Layer 3 body layout: default N-column data-grid ('columns'), or a Trello-style wide-column kanban with sticky column headers ('kanban-classic').

overridableConfigKeys.label: Body content tree
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render-ui SExpr rendered after the board loads for boardLook='columns' — the canonical column data-grid with nested per-column data-lists. boardLook='kanban-classic' renders kanbanClassicBodyContent instead; both share this trait's state machine, emits, and listens.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show the board's own search box?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Renders an inline search box above the columns. Defaults false: unlike std-browse, std-board has never had a search box, so defaulting this true would silently add one to every existing consumer. The wired path — composing std-search beside the board and routing its FILTER/SEARCH event to REFETCH_QUERY — works regardless of this knob; set true only for a standalone board with no page-level search affordance.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: inline search, board search, built-in search, show search, duplicate search

overridableConfigKeys.label: Card panel action list
overridableConfigKeys.description: Buttons on the open-card panel's actions row, built by the default cardActionsContent. Give an item `roles` to show it only to those viewer roles.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Card panel actions
overridableConfigKeys.description: Actions row of the open-card panel. Default is the Delete button only. Override to add consumer-wired actions — e.g. an Edit button with action: EDIT_CARD and actionPayload: { id: @entity.currentId, row: @entity.currentRow }, listened to by the organism's edit modal. Never leave a button here without a listener.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Card description binding
overridableConfigKeys.description: Per-card binding for the description slot.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Card entrance
overridableConfigKeys.description: Animation a card plays when it appears in a column, so a moved card visibly arrives

overridableConfigKeys.label: Card id binding
overridableConfigKeys.description: Per-card binding for the id used in action payloads.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Card look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Layer 2 visual treatment for cards rendered by this board.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Card notes binding
overridableConfigKeys.description: Per-card binding for the notes slot shown in the card detail view. Set to an empty string for hosts with no notes-equivalent field — declared as 'no notes capture', never inferred.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Card stage binding
overridableConfigKeys.description: Per-card binding for the stage/status slot.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Card title binding
overridableConfigKeys.description: Per-card binding for the title slot.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Column labels
overridableConfigKeys.description: Optional labels in the same order as the columns, used only where the board is drawn, so they may be translated; empty shows each column's own label

overridableConfigKeys.label: Columns
overridableConfigKeys.description: Board columns; each row's stage maps to a column key

overridableConfigKeys.label: Drag cards
overridableConfigKeys.description: Let people drag cards between columns and reorder them; off shows the board read-only to the pointer (moves still work through events)

overridableConfigKeys.label: Filter bar look
overridableConfigKeys.description: Visual treatment for the embedded filter bar, mirroring std-filter's own enum. Only applies when `filters` is non-empty.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: filter bar style, facet style, chips, pills

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which filters should appear above the board?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Dropdown filter facets by field, rendered as an embedded filter bar above the columns; each selection fires REFETCH_FILTER on this trait. Empty (the default) = no filter bar, which is the right setting whenever the page already composes std-filter beside this board and routes its FILTER event to REFETCH_FILTER — that is the wired owner and remains the primary path. Use this knob only for a standalone board with no page-level filter affordance.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: filter bar, faceted filters, field filters, column filters, dropdowns

overridableConfigKeys.label: New-card fields
overridableConfigKeys.description: Fields shown in the add-card form

overridableConfigKeys.label: Grid columns
overridableConfigKeys.description: Outer grid column count before the board wraps

overridableConfigKeys.label: Group-by field
overridableConfigKeys.description: Entity field whose value matches a column key — items are filtered into columns by it. Default 'stage'; set to 'status' (or any field) for entities that track state under a different name.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which relation fields to hydrate?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Entity relation field names to hydrate on fetch (e.g. an `assignee : TeamMember` field named `assignee`), so card bindings can use dot-paths like @item.assignee.name. Empty = no hydration, the default.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: relation hydration, populate relations, joined fields, hydrate relations

children.className: p-card-md border-b border-[var(--color-border)] sticky top-0 bg-[var(--color-surface)]

overridableConfigKeys.label: Kanban classic body content tree
overridableConfigKeys.description: Render-ui SExpr for boardLook='kanban-classic' — Trello-style wide elevated columns with sticky headers, dense cards with a status badge; per-item cards honor config.cardLook (the column wrapper stays elevated — it is column chrome, not a card).

overridableConfigKeys.label: Fetch page size
overridableConfigKeys.description: Records fetched per REFETCH_PAGE request. std-board renders no pagination control itself — this only feeds the fetch limit/offset when a consumer wires a composed std-pagination to REFETCH_PAGE.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: fetch limit, records per page, batch size, page limit

overridableConfigKeys.label: Which column does the search box match against?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Name the field on this entity the search box's str/includes filter matches against. Declared, never inferred: an entity with no `title` column must set this to a real field (e.g. name, summary) or the search box can never match a card.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: search column, search on field, match field, search key

overridableConfigKeys.label: Search box placeholder text
overridableConfigKeys.description: Hint text inside the board's embedded search box (e.g. 'Search cards…'). Only shown when bodySearch is true.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: search hint, placeholder, search box text, search label

overridableConfigKeys.label: Show the board's own title row?
overridableConfigKeys.description: Off when the page already carries a page header naming the same thing, so the page shows one title.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Board title
overridableConfigKeys.description: Heading shown above the column board

overridableConfigKeys.label: Viewer's role
overridableConfigKeys.description: The signed-in viewer's role that each card action's `roles` is checked against. Bind it explicitly at the call site (e.g. `viewerRole: @user.role`) in an app whose identity carries a role; left empty, only actions with no `roles` show.
